statement: ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, (∀ (N : ℝ) (j : ℤ), ‖KdVPlan.cutoff N f j‖ ≤ ‖f j‖) ∧ (∀ (j : ℤ), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f j = f j) ∧ (KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → ∀ N : ℝ, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (KdVPlan.cutoff N f))
proof:
intro f
refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro N j
  unfold KdVPlan.cutoff
  split_ifs <;> simp
· intro j
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop j.natAbs] with n hn
  apply if_pos
  have hr : |(j : ℝ)| = (j.natAbs : ℝ) := by norm_cast; exact Int.natCast_natAbs j |>.symm
  rw [hr]
  exact_mod_cast hn
· intro hf N
  change (if |((0 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ N then f 0 else 0) = 0
  rw [hf]
  split_ifs <;> rfl
